ValidationRule.description: Contact email must be lowercase with a sane @ position, no '..' in the domain, no trailing dot, and external projects cannot use 'internal.' hosts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Contact_Email__c)), OR( FIND('@', Contact_Email__c) < 2, LOWER(Contact_Email__c) <> Contact_Email__c, CONTAINS(MID(Contact_Email__c, MAX(1, FIND('@', Contact_Email__c)), 100), '..'), BEGINS(RIGHT(Contact_Email__c, MAX(0, LEN(Contact_Email__c) - FIND('@', Contact_Email__c))), '.'), RIGHT(Contact_Email__c, 1) = '.', AND(INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'External'), CONTAINS(Contact_Email__c, 'internal.')) ) )
